arguments.query: SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, b.request_id, b.passenger_id, b.flight_id, b.amount_cents, c.idempotency_key, c.status as charge_status FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status IN ("pending", "confirmed") ORDER BY b.booking_id

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, b.request_id, b.passenger_id, b.flight_id, b.amount_cents, c.idempotency_key FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending" ORDER BY b.booking_id
SELECT c.charge_id, c.booking_id, c.idempotency_key FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id LIKE "bkg_%"
SELECT c.booking_id, COUNT(*) as charge_count, GROUP_CONCAT(c.charge_id) as charge_ids FROM charges c GROUP BY c.booking_id HAVING charge_count > 0
SELECT b.booking_id, b.amount_cents, c.charge_id, c.amount_cents as charge_amount FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending"
SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type="table" AND name="bookings"
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM bookings GROUP BY status
SELECT booking_id, status FROM bookings ORDER BY booking_id
SELECT COUNT(*) as confirmed_count FROM bookings WHERE status="confirmed"
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM bookings GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charges WHERE booking_id=b.booking_id) as charge_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds WHERE booking_id=b.booking_id) as hold_count FROM bookings b WHERE b.status="confirmed" LIMIT 20
SELECT booking_id, COUNT(*) as charge_count FROM charges GROUP BY booking_id HAVING charge_count > 1
SELECT charge_id, booking_id, amount_cents FROM charges WHERE booking_id IN ("bkg_5fe9b2b81642539998dd15753c617589", "bkg_71cd5d6aca0b53c1a7532df0c0341016") ORDER BY booking_id, charge_id
SELECT * FROM refunds WHERE booking_id IN ("bkg_5fe9b2b81642539998dd15753c617589", "bkg_71cd5d6aca0b53c1a7532df0c0341016")
